with open(\"input.json\") as f: d=json.load(f)
a=sorted(d[\"actions\"],key=lambda a:a[\"id\"]); feasible=[]
for bits in itertools.product([False,True],repeat=len(a)):
 chosen=[x for x,b in zip(a,bits) if b]; ids=[x[\"id\"] for x in chosen]; s=set(ids); cost=sum(x[\"cost\"] for x in chosen)
 if cost>d[\"budget\"] or any(not set(x[\"requires\"])<=s for x in chosen) or any(set(p)<=s for p in d[\"incompatible\"]):continue
 losses={x[\"id\"]:max(0,x[\"base_loss\"]-sum(x[\"reductions\"].get(i,0) for i in ids)-sum(b[\"reduction\"] for b in x[\"bonuses\"] if set(b[\"actions\"])<=s)) for x in sorted(d[\"scenarios\"],key=lambda x:x[\"id\"])}
 worst=max(losses.values()); weighted=sum(losses[x[\"id\"]]*x[\"weight\"] for x in d[\"scenarios\"])
 feasible.append(((worst,weighted,cost,ids),losses))
k,losses=min(feasible)
print(json.dumps(dict(actions=k[3],cost=k[2],scenario_losses=losses,worst_loss=k[0],weighted_loss=k[1],feasible_portfolios=len(feasible))))'"
